tool_args.rationale: The endpoint-matched history gap and transient lag favor the coupled memory ODE. All five observations share H = 0.6, so they cannot independently identify the four kinetic parameters. Acquire the trajectory batch to measure the transient before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A later readout would add time leverage, but the trajectory batch is better targeted at resolving the fast transient and its coupling to the slow state.
The observed history gap already favors a memory mechanism; the remaining ambiguity is how its two states evolve over time.
At H = 0.6, the coupled ODE reduces to three effective coefficients on the observed inputs, so a good fit would not identify its four kinetic parameters.
It does not resolve the memory timescale or coupling.
